paite: Hiai thilte nung in van ah mipi aw hileh kilawm in, "Hallelujah! Hotdamna leh thupina leh thilhihtheihna i Pathian a ahi;
heading: Belamnou Zineihna Hallelujah
english: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

paite: avaihawmna adik in akizen hi; kizuaknu thupi leitung a, amingaihna a hihsenu tung a vai ahawm tak ziak in, ama'n asikhate sisan ama tung ah athukta," achih ka za hi.
english: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

paite: "Hallelujah! Huai khopi halna meikhu tangtawn tangtawn in azamtou hi," chi in akikou nawn uhi.
english: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

paite: Upa sawmnih-le-lite leh thil hing lite abokkhup ua, Pathian laltutphah a tupa, "Amen, Hallelujah!" chi in abia uhi.
english: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

paite: Huan laltutphah a kipan in aw ahong pawtkhia a, "Nou asikhate aw, na vek un, aneu leh alian, nou amah laute, Pathian phatna pia un," chi in.
english: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

paite: Mipi tampi aw hileh kilawm tui tampi ging bang leh vanpiging bang aw in, “Hallelujah! Toupa i Pathian Bangkim hihthei in vai ahawm ziak in,
english: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

paite: nuam ni, nakpitak in kipak ni, amah kiang ah thupina pia in; Belamnou zineih hun ahong tungta hi. Azi leng akisak khit tak ziak in;
english: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

paite: amah puanmalngat hoih leh siangthou a kizepna ding in piak in a-omta, achih ka za hi, tua puanmalngat hoih misiangthoute nasep diktatte ahi."
english: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

paite: Huan angel in ka kiang ah, "Gelh in, Belamnou zineihna nitak ankuang um ding a chial a omte ahampha uhi," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

paite: Huan amah be ding in akhebul ah ka puk hi. Huan ka kiang ah, "Hon be kei hial in; Jesu thu theihpihna kem nangmah unau leh sikha hihpih ka hi; Pathian be zaw in, Jesu thu theihpihna genkholhna kha ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

paite: Huan van kihong ka mu a; ngai in, sakol kang leh atung a tuang Ginom leh Dik kichi leng ka mu hi; ama'n dikna a vaihawm in kidouna abawl hi.
heading: Vualzou Khrist
english: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

paite: Amit meikuang bang ahi a, alutung ah lallukhu tampi a-om a, min khat amah lou ngal kuamah theih louh kigelh anei hi.
english: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

paite: Amah puan sisan a diah in akizem a; amin, "Pathian Thu,” chih ahi.
english: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

paite: Amah van a om sepaihhon puanmalngat hoih, ngou leh siangthou silh a sakol kang tung a tuang in ahon zui uhi.
english: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

paite: Akam a kipan in namte asatna ding, namsau hiam khat ahong suakkhia a; amau tung ah sikchiang in vai ahawm dia; Pathian Bangkim hihthei hehna lauhuaina uain sukna achil hi.
english: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

paite: Apuan tung leh aphei tung ah min, "KUMPIPATE' KUMPIPA, LEH TOUPATE' TOUPA," chih akigelh hi.
english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

paite: Huan angel khat ni a dingh ka mu a; amah aw ngaihtak a kikou in, van laizawl a vasa leng tengteng kiang ah, "Hong unla, Pathian nitak an thupi ah hong kikhawm vek un;
english: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

paite: Kumpipate sa, sepaih heutute sa, mihatte sa, sakolte sa, atung a tute sa, mi tengteng sa, sikha leh sikhaloute sa leh milian leh mineu sa na nektheihna ding un," achi hi.
english: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

paite: Huai gamsa leh leitung a kumpipate leh asepaihte uh, huai sakol tung a tuangpa leh asepaihte kidoupih ding in ahong kikhawm uhi.
english: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

paite: Gamsa mat in a-om a, zawlnei tak lou, ama a chiamtehna hih a gamsa chiamtehna neite leh amah limbete akhempa toh amankhawm a; anih tuak un ahing in meidil, kaat a kang sung ah paihlut in a-om uhi.
english: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

paite: Huan adangte huai sakol tung a tupa kam a kipan a hong suak namsau a thah in a-om uhi; vasa tengteng amau sa in gilvah in a-om uhi.
english: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.
